newsitem.title: USA: Imo Industries gets waiver from lenders.
newsitem.headline: Imo Industries gets waiver from lenders.

text.p: Imo Industries Inc said Wednesday its lenders had agreed to waive compliance with certain financial covenants of its senior credit agreement through February 20, 1997, to enable it and its lenders to develop mutually acceptable amendments covering the remaining term of the agreement.
The company announced last month it was in technical default of certain covenants of the credit agreement as a result of the withdrawal of its Roltra-Morse business from potential sale.
Imo had previously been granted a waiver of compliance with this covenant through December 20, 1996.

Imo Industries, with 1995 sales of $472 million from continuing operations, is a diversified manufacturer of pumps, fluid sensors, power transmission products, remote control systems, and automotive components.
